kwargs.prompt: CompletionPredictor: Ridge regression replaces heuristic weighted-sum ranker
kwargs.thinking: 11-d feature vector per (track, session_context) pair: genre_dot, mood_dot, genre_norm, mood_norm, novelty, elo_norm, phi_rank, skip_pressure, plays_log, tod_sin, tod_cos. Training: replay play history chronologically, reconstruct session context as mean embedding of preceding SESSION_WINDOW tracks, target = completion_rate. sklearn Ridge(alpha=10.0). Fit at session restore after TagEmbedder + CoPlayRanker have written genre_vec/mood_vec/phi_rank (features depend on them). predict_all writes predicted_completion annotation for every track using current session context. TrackRanker.score() checks ann.get('predicted_completion') first; full heuristic weighted-sum remains as fallback when annotation absent. MIN_SAMPLES=30 guard prevents fitting on sparse histories.
kwargs.outcome: 33 new tests pass. Full suite 2003/2003. TrackRanker now uses a learned Ridge model when >=30 plays exist with completion_rate; falls back to the 5-dimension EG-weighted heuristic otherwise. Checkpoint at ~/.phi/completion_predictor.npz.
